name: timing-reset-after-flush
description: Asserts the one thing shared-core changed: an explicit flush RE-ANCHORES the periodic schedule. Before, the next tick landed on the original anchor; now it lands one interval after the flush. Deliberately minimal - 12s of foreground is enough for a stable cadence to re-anchor away from. Reset values are derived, not fixed: upload = stats.upload_flush_interval_ms, disk = effective_flush_interval(disk_flush_interval_ms, upload_flush_interval_ms). With this account (disk 5s pushed, upload 60s default) that is 5s disk / 60s upload.

steps.why: two disk ticks at 5s establish the pre-flush anchor unambiguously
the re-anchored flush must land ~5s after the forced flush, NOT on the old anchor
